evals.prompt: Medium feature with unclear integration: we need an architecture packet for a B2B notifications service that talks to email and webhooks. Keep it sized for Medium — not an enterprise eight-artifact dump. Prefer logical views before AWS icons.
evals.expected_output: A sized Medium packet: architecture brief, context + container views, one dynamic flow, top ADRs/risks; logical-first; no mandatory full enterprise packet or vendor-icon focus.
assertions: Produces or outlines an architecture brief with outcome and top quality attributes
Includes system context and container (or layered) views
Includes at least one dynamic/workflow view
Records ADRs or major decisions and a lite risk register (or top risks)
Explicitly sizes for Medium rather than requiring a full eight-artifact enterprise packet
States logical architecture before vendor/cloud icon mapping (or equivalent)

evals.prompt: Just draft the feature REQs for password reset with acceptance criteria — no diagrams.
evals.expected_output: Declines to run a full architecture packet session as primary work; redirects to spec-driven-workflow / feature spec drafting.
assertions: Does not produce a full C4 architecture packet as the primary deliverable
Recognizes the ask as feature requirements / SDD rather than solution architecture
Redirects to or recommends spec-driven-workflow / draft-spec (or equivalent)

evals.prompt: Design our CI/CD promotion model across dev/stage/prod and rollback strategy.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as DevOps strategy, not C4 solution architecture; redirects to devops-strategy-facilitator.
assertions: Declines or redirects away from a C4 architecture packet as the primary response
Recognizes the ask as delivery/CI-CD strategy rather than solution architecture diagrams

evals.prompt: Large AI agent platform: produce the architecture packet including AI lifecycle/governance and risk controls. Do not invent DDS departmental policy.
evals.expected_output: Large + AI packet with brief, C4 views, deployment/trust, AI lifecycle view, ADRs, AI-aware risks; portable guidance without org-specific DDS policy invention.
assertions: Includes AI lifecycle/governance considerations (evals, versions, monitoring, or human escalation)
Covers deployment or trust boundaries for Large scope
Addresses AI-specific risks (e.g. prompt injection, excessive agency, data in logs) with prevent/detect/respond style controls
Does not invent organization-specific DDS/departmental policy as settled fact
Keeps logical architecture before vendor logo mapping
